probe: PROBE-A part 2: action of HH^1(H_5(zeta_5)) on the cocenter HH_0
description: Tests whether the unique outer derivation of H_5 at the Bring root of unity induces a nonzero map on HH_0 = A/[A,A]. Inner derivations act as zero on HH_0, so the induced action is canonically attached to the HH^1 class. Since every trace factors through HH_0, a zero induced action means the class is trace-blind and cannot carry c_3.
method: D(A) computed by Leibniz extension along reduced words from the outer generator of the derivation nullspace; [A,A] spanned by all [T_u, T_v]; test is rank([A,A] + D(A)) == rank([A,A]).
rigour_note: Reduction mod a prime above p is a ring hom so rank_p <= rank_0; a NON-trivial action found mod p therefore persists to characteristic 0. The trivial direction is corroborated across two unrelated primes but is not by itself a characteristic-0 proof.
